_comment: Held-out perplexity eval set. Mirrors mix.json's source composition so
perplexity is measured on the same domains REAP calibration targets
(ja/en chat+wiki, code), but must not overlap with what calibration
already consumed from the same streams.
build_calibration.py only applies ds.shuffle(seed=...) to sources that
declare a shuffle_buffer (mix.json only sets one for the *-wiki sources;
the instruct/chat sources stream from the start of their split with no
shuffle at all, so re-reading them would return the exact same leading
documents calibration already used). Every source here gets its own
shuffle_buffer + a seed distinct from mix.json's (0), so all seven draw
from a different, non-overlapping slice of each source.
num_samples is deliberately smaller than calibration's 512 -- perplexity
just needs a stable mean over held-out tokens, not full REAP saliency
DeepSeek-V4 variant: same sources, seeds and sizes as ppl-holdout.json so
the two models' perplexity is measured on the same documents; only the
prompt encoding differs (DeepSeek ships no chat_template, so
how calibration was built in calib/mix-dsv4.json).
